audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer describes a DIFFERENT, pre-rework Aurelion Sol. It names Starsurge, Celestial Expansion, Voice of Light and 'empowered comet damage' — none of which exist in this kit — and it puts the abilities that DO exist in the wrong slots, calling Singularity '(R)' and Voice of Light '(E)'. Ten separate fields are affected: spikes[0..2], early, mid, late, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0..2].
audit.why: The kit file gives the real set: Cosmic Creator (P, Stardust that permanently improves every ability), Breath of Light (Q, a 3s channelled beam at 750), Astral Flight (W, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, flies over terrain), Singularity (E, 12s at 750, percent-health damage that executes at the centre) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100 at 1250, stun). A player reading the old page is tracking a stun that no longer opens his kit and ignoring the beam that actually kills them.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real ability in the real slot. Added the three interactions the page never carried: Breath of Light is a CHANNEL, so any CC you land — including Chum the Waters' knockup — cancels it outright; Singularity does percent-health damage and executes below a threshold at its centre, so MR is not the answer and 'even HP' is not safe HP; and Astral Flight at 22 seconds is his only exit, which makes its downtime the whole green light.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[6] and packet.levelChart both read 'Aurelion Sol'. The last row of the chart disagreed across layers, and phases[6].why described FIZZ erasing a carry underneath a row that was supposed to belong to the enemy.
audit.why: Cosmic Creator makes his abilities permanently stronger as Stardust accumulates, and Singularity's percent-health damage plus centre execute is exactly what punishes a solo dive at two items. The other six rows are correctly Fizz and both layers already agree on them.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side moved to Aurelion Sol and phases[6].why rewritten in the same proposal to state why he wins that stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and breakdown.spikes claimed the string 'one-shots squishies' with no source; dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' when Astral Flight is 22 seconds at rank 1.
audit.why: No magnitudes appear in either kit. Astral Flight is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 — the invitation is twenty-two seconds early and sixteen late, and getting that number right is the difference between a free dive and walking into his exit.
audit.corrected: Magnitude claims replaced with the Stardust scaling story; the invitation corrected to twenty-two seconds.

audit.why: Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Breath of Light a 3s channel, Singularity 12s, Falling Star 120/110/100.
audit.corrected: All four written in, with the terrain-crossing note on Astral Flight and the channel note on the beam.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol is clunky and immobile in the early game — his only real threat is landing Starsurge (Q) from range, and if it misses he has a long cooldown with almost no way to escape your E jump engage. notes:
THIS IS THE WORST MATCHUP IN MY SLICE AND IT NEEDS A SECOND LOOK. The whole content layer was written for the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol. It names Starsurge, Celestial Expansion, Voice of Light and 'empowered comet damage' — four abilities that do not exist in the current kit — and it assigns the two real abilities it does mention to the wrong slots (Singularity called (R), Voice of Light called (E)). The packet flagged zero suspectNames for this matchup, so the name checker did not catch a single one of them; it only detects near-miss spellings, and these are correctly-spelled names of abilities that were removed from the game. Ten content fields were affected and I rewrote all ten. Worth checking whether other champions' pages against aurelionsol carry the same pre-rework text.

CHART: only phases[6].side disagreed with content win[6] and packet.levelChart (full said Skill, both others said Aurelion Sol), and its why described Fizz erasing a carry under a row meant to belong to the enemy. I moved the side and rewrote the why together. No paired win[6] edit — win[6] already reads 'Aurelion Sol' on disk. The other six rows already agreed at Fizz.

THREE MISSING INTERACTIONS ADDED, all from the brief: Breath of Light is a channel that any CC cancels (so your R knockup and E slam both break it); Singularity does percent-health damage and executes at its centre, which makes stacked MR the wrong answer and 'even HP' a false read; Astral Flight is his only exit at 22s, so its downtime is the commit window.
